scope.catalog_scope: Concierge fashion inventory: apparel, footwear and fashion accessories. Beauty, home, furniture, jewelry/watches and other non-clothing merchandise are outside this clothing-focused audit except where an item is wearable fashion.

completed_actions: Recovered the existing shared ProductMaster architecture and SCHEELS/Macy's/Nordstrom controlled inventory methodology without schema changes.
Confirmed no pre-existing Kohl's RetailerOffer or Kohl's CatalogSource records existed before Inventory Audit #004.
Confirmed Kohl's public site map exposes the intended clothing, footwear and fashion-accessory department structure.
Confirmed Kohl's public robots file declares an official XML sitemap.
Tested the official robots and sitemap endpoints from the Base44 application environment; both returned Akamai HTTP 403.
Validated three current product pages spanning men's, women's and kids' apparel and created only explicitly observed variants.
Kept the Levi's offer availability unknown because no size was selected; no size availability was inferred from the general size chart.
Did not infer local store inventory or stock quantities.
Did not promote retailer-hosted product images into public ProductMaster image fields because attribution alone does not establish display rights.
Recorded both a completed controlled verification run and a partial full-audit run in both Base44 apps.

source_findings.public_department_visibility: Kohl's public site map and live category pages expose broad fashion department coverage including women, men, juniors, kids, baby, plus, maternity, footwear, accessories and sports-fan apparel.
source_findings.product_page_visibility: Current public product pages expose product name, brand, price, colors, selected size where present, retailer SKU and product details sufficient for controlled row validation.
source_findings.bulk_source_gap: The officially declared XML sitemap cannot be fetched from the Base44 server environment because Akamai returns HTTP 403, preventing reliable exhaustive server-side enumeration.
source_findings.dynamic_page_gap: Category pages are large, dynamic and paginated and are not treated as an exhaustive product/variant/availability feed.
source_findings.prohibited_workaround: No blocked/private endpoint or access-control bypass was used.
source_findings.required_for_full_completion: An authorized Kohl's bulk product feed/API/export or another permitted machine-readable source accessible to the ingestion environment with product identifiers, variants, current price and availability.

data_quality_rule: Do not infer unobserved size/color stock, do not treat a size chart as proof that a size is currently offered, and keep retailer-side product IDs/SKUs in offer/source provenance rather than treating them as manufacturer-global identity.
next_operational_dependency: Authorized Kohl's bulk product source accessible from the application environment.
